statement: A change withdraws only its own candidate: the store removes the candidate of a document only while it is still the one of that change's window, in one atomic step, so the late withdrawal of a change that is abandoned, closed, rejected or preempted never removes the candidate of the change that took its slot. A control-plane lease is released only while it is still its holder's, in one atomic step, and a holder that takes its own lease again holds it for the full duration from then on, as the in-memory store does, so a task never loses the lease it has just renewed.
